plugins.name: gardener
plugins.description: Audit and improve repository health — docs sync, best practices, security hygiene, skill extraction, and maintenance of its own support-file checklists.

plugins.name: ticket
plugins.description: File-based, in-repo ticket workflow: init → create → grill → check → triage → fix. Tickets are numbered Markdown files in the repository, separate from GitHub Issues.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Session-aware git commit helpers: /commit-session commits only files changed this session, /commit-all commits every dirty file — both grouped into semantically coherent Conventional-Commits commits.
